title: Martinfish 2.0 Adopted Me
summary: Martinfish 2.0: fixed rotation where Stockfish plays two moves, then Martin plays one, repeating. Player (white, Trompowsky d4/Bg5) times tactics for Martin's turns (e.g. Bxf6 when Martin moves next, though Martin recaptures). Solid development, pressure with Qb3; Martin's weak moves (e.g. ...xc3, undeveloped bishop) accumulate and the player wins with a ladder mate after Stockfish's final Kh6. Ends with the Martinfish logo 'disappearing' teaser.
rules: Bot move schedule repeats: Stockfish, Stockfish, Martin (Stockfish 2 moves : Martin 1 move).
